item.title: FIT FOR A KING Announces New Album 'LONELY GOD', Shares Lead Single And Tracklist
item.description: Fit For A King have unveiled Lonely God, their eighth studio album, scheduled to arrive August 1, 2025 via Solid State Records. The announcement came with a music video (available at the end of this article) for the blistering title track, which showcases the band’s signature blend of gnarly riffs, guttural growls, heavy grooves, and a dash of industrial crunch.

item.title: BRIAN WELCH on KORN's New Album: 'We're Doing It All On Tape'
item.description: Korn is back in the studio, but don’t expect any instant gratification. This time, they’re ditching modern convenience for a much older, sweatier process. During a chat with BBC Radio 1’s Rock Show With Daniel P Carter (as transcribed by The PRP, guitarist Brian “Head” Welch explained that the band has fully embraced analog recording.

item.title: DAVE MUSTAINE starts recording vocals as MEGADETH’s 17th studio album nears completion
item.description: The next Megadeth record has been crawling toward completion for months. Since the release of The Sick, The Dying… and the Dead! back in 2022, work on its successor has quietly advanced.

item.title: Kirk Hammett Rules Out Retirement From Metallica Despite 62 Years of Age
item.description: Kirk Hammett has no interest in slowing down. Speaking to Metal Hammer, he dismissed the idea of retirement entirely. “I don’t believe in retirement. Retirement is something that’s been forced onto people; I don’t believe musicians are allowed to retire,” he said.
